result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps with tactile warning surfaces. However, safety is compromised by significantly faded crosswalk markings and the absence of dedicated pedestrian signals, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular traffic lights.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk is severely worn and nearly invisible, reducing driver awareness of the pedestrian crossing zone.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: There are no dedicated walk/don't-walk signals, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicular lights which may not provide sufficient clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree near the corner may partially obscure pedestrians from the view of drivers approaching the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with continental or ladder-style markings to improve visibility for approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: A residential intersection featuring basic sidewalks and faded transverse crosswalk markings. The environment lacks high-visibility crossing treatments and dedicated pedestrian signals, which may result in reduced driver awareness of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the side street on the left side of the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signalization
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signals are visible to provide a protected crossing interval.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to significantly improve visibility for drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and reduce the speed of turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Actuated Warning Systems
interventions.description: Install Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFBs) to alert drivers when a pedestrian is intending to cross.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized residential intersection with sidewalks but a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings or dedicated pedestrian signals. The wide, unmarked pavement and lack of traffic calming measures prioritize vehicle flow over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: Despite being a signalized intersection, there are no painted crosswalks to guide pedestrians or alert drivers.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt surface could present a trip hazard or uneven footing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection is controlled by traffic signals but lacks essential pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signal heads. The roadway surface is in poor condition with significant cracking and nearly non-existent lane markings, creating a disorganized environment for all users.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to crossing locations at this signalized intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and middle ground.

hazards.name: Missing pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The absence of pedestrian signal heads leaves walkers without information on when it is safe to cross relative to vehicle traffic phases.
hazards.location_in_image: On the traffic signal poles at the intersection.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement surface
hazards.description: Extensive cracking and patching on the road surface create tripping hazards and may affect vehicle braking or handling.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve crossing safety and predictability.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing and Restriping
interventions.description: Repair the damaged pavement and apply clear lane markings to better organize traffic flow and improve visibility.
